_comment: Obsidian Color Math factory default configuration. This file serves as an immutable reference. To customize settings, use the in-app plugin Settings tab or edit 'data.json'. If 'data.json' has syntax errors or missing keys, Color Math safely falls back to these defaults.

_role_descriptions.derivative: Outer derivatives and prime markers (e.g. f'(x), \frac{d}{dx}, \frac{∂}{∂t})
_role_descriptions.chain: Chain rule factors and subscripts (e.g. g'(x), y_i)
_role_descriptions.upper: Superscripts and matrix outer wrappers (e.g. x^2, A^T)
_role_descriptions.unit: Physical units and metric prefixes (e.g. μm, m/s, kg)

_unicode_descriptions.greekStyle: Greek letter typography: 'plane1' (Mathematical Italic: 𝝍, 𝝰) or 'standard' (ψ, α)
_unicode_descriptions.convertDefiniteIntegrals: Convert bounded integrals like \int_a^b to ∫_a^b (default: false to preserve vertical TeX limits)
_unicode_descriptions.convertBoundedOperators: Convert bounded summations/products like \sum_{i=1}^n to ∑_{i=1}^n (default: false)
_unicode_descriptions.convertProseToUnicode: Convert LaTeX commands like \psi to 𝜓 in regular text outside math blocks (default: false to protect prose)
_unicode_descriptions.convertProseToLatex: Convert Unicode symbols like 𝝍 back to \psi in regular text outside math blocks (default: false)
